nom: Peter Thomas Roth Even Clearer Therapeutic Sulfur Mask

avis.texte: Why? I will not order again until added perfume and fragrances are removed. You ruined a good product. Sad.

I purchased this for my teenager with acne after trying many other products with no results. We use this product 2-3 times per week with amazing progress. His skin is clearing with less breakouts. We also use the Goodbye Acne gel and have had no issues with skin drying.

I bought to help with rosacea flareups and help with the pores on my nose. These are the results after the first use. I can see improvement and will use once a week. The sulfur smell is off putting, but it's only temporary. Since it works, I can handle the smell

I loveee this product - I have PCOS and suffer from cystic acne - due to this a 10% sulfur treatment is one of the only things to help with my acne (since its under the skin). This product isnt too aggressive (doesnt damage my skin barrier) while delivering great results in helping shrink stubborn cystic bumps. When I get an occasional pimple it also does great in drying it out. Also this stuff lasts you for soo long (you only need a lil bit on spots - dont cake it on thick) I'm only just now buying another tub after a year - and I use this product very frequently !!

avis.titre: Acne prone, texture and sensitive skin hereeee
avis.texte: I am obsessed with this face mask!! I have sensitive skin but also deal with a lot of closed comedones that if not treat it turns into an inflammed pimple. I have been using this mask 3x per week with no sensitivity, no more breakouts and the texture is looking WAY better already. Also i love to use it as a spot treatment overnight.
I used to use this product regularly to calm my skin. Now they've added fragrance. I have sensitive skin and cannot use products with fragrance.
Me and my husband use this a few times a week! It works great!
Me and my husband use this a few times a week! It works great!

avis.titre: Change back to the old formula
avis.texte: I used this for years, will no longer use becsuse you added fragrence. I have acne why would I want added fragrance. The mask before didnt even smell.
Nobody using a sulfur mask wants fragrance in it. We know sulfur smells bad, the fragrance isnt making it any better! Just makes it more irritating to the skin.

This is the first sulfer product I've tried. I've made other lifestyle changes, new face wash... as well as adding this. But, I've never had such great results from a product. I use it in my night routine and I love the way my skin looks in the morning. Can really see an improvement over night. I've only tried the new formula which was from a sample pack but I wish it didn't have any fragrance.
I cant imagine why you would change this product! been using it for 10 years at least and now it has fragrance....the last thing anyone who needs this product would want.

My skin has always responded well to sulfur and this is amazing for my skin. I use it 2-3 times a week just like it says and i SWEAR then constant small zits on my cheeks no longer is a problem. I have never in my life finished a whole container of a facemask but i KNOW i will with this and I'll definitely repurchase.

I've used this mask for at least a decade now and they changed the formula adding in a fragrance that quite frankly stinks. It's far worse than the sulfur smell ever was. Even if it works I don't think I can use it now and it was very expensive to waste.

avis.titre: This is a fantastic mask for redness and mild acne
avis.texte: I really like this mask, it doesn't sting or smell bad. I find that it calms my redness and reduces my acne, especially hormonal acne. A little goes a long way. I recommend this and will buy it again.
